title: Vampire Vape Koncept Simply Blackcurrant E-Liquid Short Fill 50ml
description: Fruit purists will love the no-nonsense simplicity of Vampire Vape’s Simply Blackcurrant from their Koncept collection. Juicy, tart blackcurrants lend their rich sweetness to this exquisite vape that’ll have you coming back for more. These short fill bottles contain 50ml of nicotine-free liquid, with 10ml of extra space within the bottle to accommodate your nicotine shot of choice. This allows you to create a liquid with your own desired nicotine strength. Typically, adding a 10ml nicotine shot to a 50ml short fill will give you 60ml of 3mg e-liquid. Once you have added your preferred amount of nicotine, make sure you shake the contents of the short fill bottle well.
